name: sun-arc
title: Sun Arc
description: A time-of-day picker drawn as the sun's real path over a city: sunrise, solar noon and sunset come from a solar-position model for a latitude, longitude and day, and the sky, the light on the water and the lit windows follow the sun's altitude. With a `photo` of the place, its own sky is replaced by the one for the chosen time, the sun stands at its true azimuth and altitude through the photo's lens, and the foreground is relit. UI SDK's slider in minutes since local midnight, with setTime, sunrise, sunset and solarNoon for agents, and calibrate for a photo.

[data-slot=\"sun-arc-sky\"].background: linear-gradient( to bottom, var(--sun-arc-zenith) 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-zenith), var(--sun-arc-horizon) 45%) 38%, var(--sun-arc-horizon) var(--sun-arc-horizon-at) )

[data-slot=\"sun-arc-path\"].mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black var(--sun-arc-horizon-at), rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4) var(--sun-arc-horizon-at))

[data-slot=\"sun-arc-ground\"].background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 5px), linear-gradient( to bottom, color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-horizon) 46%, #0a0f1a), color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-zenith) 30%, #05070c) )

[data-slot=\"sun-arc-glow\"].background: radial-gradient( circle closest-side, rgb(var(--sun-arc-light) / 0.75) 0%, rgb(var(--sun-arc-light) / 0.28) 26%, rgb(var(--sun-arc-light) / 0.08) 60%, transparent )

[data-slot=\"sun-arc-glint\"].mask-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, black 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px), radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 100% at 50% 0, black, transparent)

[data-slot=\"sun-arc-stage\"] [data-slot.background: radial-gradient( circle at 50% 45%, #fffef6 0%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-sun), white 40%) 45%, var(--sun-arc-sun) 100% )
[data-slot=\"sun-arc-stage\"] [data-slot.box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-sun), white 30%), 0 0 18px 4px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-glow) 70%, transparent), 0 0 46px 14px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-glow) 30%, transparent)
0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-sun), white 30%), 0 0 0 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45), 0 0 46px 14px color-mix(in oklab, var(--sun-arc-glow) 30%, transparent)

docs: `<SunArc label latitude longitude date timeZone value|defaultValue onValueChange onValueCommit step locale disabled name labels>`. The value is minutes since local midnight in `timeZone` (the runtime's own without one), 0 to 1439; it starts at solar noon. Times and degrees are written with `Intl` in `locale`. The arc is UI SDK's Slider: arrows move `step` minutes (5 by default), Page Up and Down an hour, Home and End the ends of the day; drag the sun or press the sky (the ground strip on touch). The Sunrise, Solar noon and Sunset buttons move the sun there; in a polar day or night, sunrise and sunset are disabled and the agent's step fails with why. The stage is a sky in every theme (the item's `css`); the card and readout follow the theme. `photo={{ src, heading?, fov?, horizon?, skyMask?, capturedAt?, keepClouds?, windowGlow? }}` draws the sky into a photo of the place (`keepClouds` keeps the photo's own clouds, lit white, golden or dark with the sun, off by default; `windowGlow` lights a seeded share of the windows at dusk and night, on by default): the sky is found locally (`sky-photo`, no model download) or taken from `skyMask`; the heading comes from the EXIF compass, the field of view from the 35 mm focal length (69° without it) and the horizon from the skyline's lowest band. Without a heading the Calibrate panel opens: Mark the sun (press where the sun stands in the photo at its capture time, from the EXIF or `capturedAt`), and Heading, Field of view and Horizon sliders. Each calibration comes out in `onPhotoChange` for the app to keep; nothing is stored. Outside the view the sun waits at the edge it left by, with an arrow; below the horizon it waits on the horizon. `SunArcPhotoUpload label onPhoto` picks a local photo through an object URL (never uploaded) and gives its EXIF place. The demo photo is the Cebu City skyline by DisRaptor18, CC0 (Wikimedia Commons, File:Cebu_city_skyline_2025.jpg).
